tools.name: get_exchange_rate
tools.description: Official reference exchange rate of a currency pair (European Central Bank, Federal Reserve or Bank of England, published once per business day), for the latest date or a past date, with an optional amount to convert. Not a live market quote.

tools.name: get_exchange_rates
tools.description: Latest official reference rates of one base currency against every quote currency the site lists, with the daily change.

tools.name: get_exchange_rate_history
tools.description: Daily official reference rates of a currency pair between two dates (at most 366 days per request), oldest first.

tools.name: get_economic_calendar
tools.description: Scheduled economic data releases and central bank rate decisions between two dates (at most 31 days, from 90 days back), with times in UTC. Dates come from the statistics offices' and central banks' own calendars.

tools.name: get_policy_rates
tools.description: Current policy interest rate of each central bank the site covers, the date it took effect, the previous rate and the next scheduled decision.

tools.name: get_economic_indicator
tools.description: Recent values of one official economic indicator (inflation, unemployment, GDP growth, policy rate, 10-year bond yield and more) for one country, newest first, with source, unit and frequency.

tools.name: get_market_sentiment
tools.description: Latest value (0 to 100) of the Investember Crypto Fear & Greed Index or Market Risk Appetite Index, its zone, its components and its daily history. Both are our own published formulas, recomputed once a day.

tools.name: calculate_position_size
tools.description: Position size in lots for a trade that risks a set share of the account at a given stop loss distance in pips. Converts the pip value into the account currency with the latest ECB reference rates.
